decisions: Minutes from the November 7, 2025 board meeting approved as amended (Q3 revenue figure corrected to $4.35M).
Pierre Dubois authorized to engage legal counsel for formal collection proceedings on two overdue invoices totaling $310,000.
Q4 2025 revenue planning baseline set at $4.75M.
Northwind Partners scope expansion approved; Letter of Intent to be signed by Margaret Holvan no later than December 19, 2025.
Aiyana Park directed to hire one senior consultant with a start date no later than January 15, 2026 (onboarding budget: $45,000).
Pierre Dubois to submit tiered pricing proposal with performance-based incentive clause to Northwind Partners by December 12, 2025.
Additional $55,000 budget allocation approved for cybersecurity licensing modules related to the cloud migration project.
6% salary increase approved for all mid-level consultants effective January 1, 2026.
2026 performance bonus pool of $180,000 approved, to be administered by the CEO.
Annual remote work stipend of $1,200 per eligible employee approved for 2026.
Three 2026 strategic pillars endorsed: Client Portfolio Diversification, Data Analytics Advisory Practice Launch (Q2 2026), and Brand and Market Presence.
Margaret Holvan to deliver 2026 Strategic Plan document to all board members by January 9, 2026.
Executive leads assigned per strategic pillar: Holvan (Brand & Market Presence), Dubois (Portfolio Diversification tracking), Park (Service Line Expansion).
